name: study 176, one study in two groups: A draws laws blind on as 174 did, ten new batches of 1,000; B maps the ten best scorers not yet known, each coupling moved alone and lines halved toward the nearest law of another kind; each group half the work slots by default
question: The operator's question (2026-10-13): can simple local rules make a graph grow a real dimension, like space; which keep one they are given; and can the null map predict a law before it runs? Study 169 is the first study on the final probes, the installed table and the deterministic fleet (800 to 806), run on 813, its data the first clean data (the operator, 2026-11-19 21:11: "This way, we immediately have clean data from our latest codebase").

decided.why_now: the operator, 2026-11-24 16:33: "both searches will have to merge into 1, the top 10 scores being auto-explored/mapped automatically for every best scorer"; 17:37: one workload of groups A (the blind draw), B (the map of the best) and C (the cores the system keeps); 17:39: "the simply 50-50 default split in two, much easier to argue for and is bias neutral"
decided.groups: each campaign carries its group (study_design.group); the folder's work_groups flag gives A and B half each by default (`python3 main.py workload --split A=1,B=1`), each group with work given slots toward its share of the simulations running, a group with nothing queued leaving its slots to the other until it has work again; the system's CPUs (`main.py workload --system-cpus`) are none until the operator names them
decided.blind: A is 174's design on ten new search seeds: the same grid, starts, ladder, budgets and gates, a batch of 1,000 laws each
decided.map: B starts from the ten best laws of 174's bundle of 2026-11-24 14:22Z and 175's of 08:35Z together under the score in force, gsd-law-score-9 (`study_176_first_ten.json`, written by `tools/map_first_ten.py`): each is run again, each of its real parameters moved alone by a tenth up and down, and a line toward its nearest law of the same terms whose kind at 4,096 differs, at least 0.001 away, is halved four times where the kind flips. A region is known when every point of it is decided and its lines are done; it then records its kind, the size from which that kind is called on every point that reaches it, and its boundaries, and leaves the ten; the next best law of the study not in a region comes in, read again at every controller pass at most once a minute. B's gates are 175's: starts_alike and nothing_read only record, so that no point is stopped on a judgment its holder passed
decided.open: asked of the operator in the notes: whether a variant moves a coupling by a tenth or by 175's 0.001, and whether four halvings are enough
decided.seeds: the eleven search seeds drawn with Python's secrets.randbits(63) at 2026-11-24T17:00:58Z; the map campaign draws nothing
